Subject: Q3 results and next steps

Dear Team,

Our Q3 revenue grew 14% YoY to Rs 42 crore, and EBITDA margin improved to 18%. The CEO will present the numbers at the board meeting on 14 November. GST collections were in line with our forecast.

The KYC backlog fell to 320 cases. We signed an MoU with Konkan Bank for supply-chain finance, and the first disbursement is due in December.

Please send your inputs by Friday.

Best regards,
Meera
